objective: Repair proven non-decision observability and test-harness defects from the Sept21 paper session; prepare explicit approval scope for actual-frame freshness enforcement.
preserve: installed paper service and private binding

workstreams.name: logging and session evidence
workstreams.acceptance: Real deployed formatter emits escaped JSON with explicitUTC; collector selects new canonical session log safely without old invalid rotations permanently blocking future days, and missing/malformed current evidence still fails closed.

workstreams.name: readiness diagnostics
workstreams.acceptance: Bounded allowlisted HTTPstatus/component/reason diagnostics retained on nonready without secrets, raw errors or changed recovery decisions.

workstreams.name: nightly validation harness
workstreams.acceptance: Identify explicit required services/fixtures and credentials; fix deterministic fixtures and separate external integration evidence honestly. No weakened assertions, silent skippedcoverage or production credentials/services.

workstreams.name: frozen freshness specification
workstreams.acceptance: Specify actual-frame age at final submission acrossstreaming/REST, replay impact and cutoff implications for explicit approval. No decisionpath changes.

required_validation: settings/config coordinator/system integration for config changes
independent review and openPR with artifacts
done_condition: Tested nonfrozen fixes committed on featurebranch with PR open and evidence attached; frozen decision change remains a concrete reviewed approval item.
discovered_validation_requirements: External import-time diagnostic probes must be intercepted before importing their modules; exact test registry drift must fail collection
Parser rejection of a responding readiness endpoint must not introduce restart authority
Canonical JSON logs must reject duplicate/nonfinite values and support literal Unicode separators
Runtime snapshot is offline defaults in isolated validation, not proof of installed configuration
